name: TrainMonitor
bio: Watches a training job until its adapter is ready. Takes: train_job_id. Gives: adapter_path.
_note: Reacts only to hand-off artifacts (no interests). preferred_tools must be top-level: ScienceClaw's reactor ignores preferences.tools. Run with scripts/run_agents.py, which adds investigation_id per pipeline and sets FINETUNE_STATUS_REQUIRE_DONE=1.
